changelog:
- Initial release of Code Review Assistant.
- Analyzes code changes for bugs, security, performance, maintainability, and style issues.
- Provides actionable, file- and line-specific feedback with severity classification.
- Summarizes risk level, top findings, positives, and follow-up suggestions.
- Supports reviews for GitHub, GitLab, and local git changes; adapts depth to PR size.
summary: AI-powered code review assistant that analyzes pull requests for bugs, security issues, performance problems, and style violations with actionable feedback.
